subject: SIG questionnaire: encryption artifacts and ephemeral key rotation plan
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@finserve.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-09-25T14:03:00Z
Subject: SIG questionnaire: encryption artifacts and ephemeral key rotation plan

Irene / Laura —

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our SIG KMS section and a short set of clarifying questions specific to key custody and rotation. High level asks: we need artifacts that demonstrate how Redwood manages keys for customer data (both at-rest and in-transit), HSM attestation evidence, and rotation proof for the last 12 months. Specifically:

- HSM attestation(s) and vendor-signed seals (if available)
- KMS key lifecycle documentation (creation, rotation, revocation) and sample rotation logs
- Access matrix showing which principals have decrypt/encrypt/export permissions
- Evidence that keys cannot be exported in plaintext (BYOK constraints)
- TLS cipher-suite policy and any MITM protections for tenant traffic
- Sample signing operations and test vectors used for rotation verification

File: FinServe_SIG_KMS_questions.xlsx (xlsx) — quick template we filled in; redline where needed.

TLP: The questionnaire is marked TLP:AMBER — please share artifacts via secure link. Can we get an initial package by COB 2029-09-30? If that timeline is tight, please advise soon.

Appreciate a point of contact for delivery and a single package (or clear staging plan) so we can validate quickly.

Regards,
Asha Menon
Head of Security Assurance
FinServe Capital
asha.menon@finserve.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@finserve.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-09-25T16:10:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: encryption artifacts and ephemeral key rotation plan

Asha —

Thanks for the clear template and asks. We'll assemble a two-part deliverable: (1) an "evidence bundle" that includes attestation PDFs, config snapshots, and redacted logs; and (2) a "rotation test kit" with sample logs and test vectors you can run locally. Proposed plan:

- 2029-09-27: Internal stub describing what will be shared (owners + file inventory) — owner: Marissa Cole
- 2029-09-29 (EOD): Evidence bundle uploaded to secure Drive + expiring S3 links — owner: Marissa Cole
- 2029-09-30 (COB): Signed attestation (DocuSign) and rotation-playbook + test vectors — owner: Nikhil Sharma

Couple of clarifications we need from you: do you require vendor-signed HSM attestation (from our HSM provider) or is a Redwood-signed summary acceptable for initial review? Also confirm whether any artifacts should be delivered directly into your secure portal (we can push via SFTP) versus links.

We'll follow the TLP:AMBER guidance and avoid sending full keystore exports. If you prefer, Marissa will mark particularly sensitive items as TLP:RED and deliver them via pre-signed S3 with narrow IP restrictions.

I'll loop in Marissa and Nikhil to begin prep.

Thanks,

Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@finserve.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-09-29T16:45:00Z
Subject: Evidence bundle and rotation test kit — FinServe SIG KMS section

Asha —

Per Irene's plan, we've uploaded the initial evidence set and the rotation test kit. Summary of what is attached/shared:

Attachments (stubs):
- kms-rotation-202808-202909.csv (redacted rotation events, timestamped)
- hsm-attestation-2029-06.pdf (vendor attestation and seal)
- transit-tls-configuration.txt (active TLS policy and cipher suites)
- byok-policy-summary.pdf (BYOK constraints and import/export rules)
- rotation-playbook-v1.2.pdf (step-by-step rotation & rollback procedure)
- sample-redacted-rotation-logs.log (log excerpts with tenant IDs redacted)
- signing-test-vector-001.json (JSON test vector for verifying signature/cipher outputs)

Delivery links:
- Secure Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3C4D5E6F (access limited to FinServe and Redwood SSO)
- Large/sensitive artifacts via pre-signed S3 (expires in 1 hour): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-secure/finserve-evidence?X-Amz-Expires=3600
- DocuSign envelope for the attestation: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123

Notes: the HSM attestation is the vendor-signed PDF we received in June 2029. The rotation CSV contains event IDs and non-sensitive metadata; we redacted tenant identifiers. If you need a deeper audit extract (with redaction approval), we can prepare an escrow extract under NDA.

Let me know if you'd prefer a short walkthrough (we can record a 10–12 minute demo of a simulated rotation including log verification).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: kms-rotation-202808-202909.csv, hsm-attestation-2029-06.pdf, transit-tls-configuration.txt, byok-policy-summary.pdf, rotation-playbook-v1.2.pdf, sample-redacted-rotation-logs.log, signing-test-vector-001.json

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@finserve.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, FinServe Security Team <security@finserve.com>
Date: 2029-09-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence bundle and rotation test kit — FinServe SIG KMS section

Marissa / Irene —

Thanks — we received the Drive link and downloaded the redacted CSV and attestation PDF. A few quick follow-ups: 

1) Can you confirm whether private keys used for tenant encryption are ever exportable from the HSM plaintext memory? Our reviewers are specifically concerned about BYOK exports and want explicit wording that keys cannot be exported in plaintext without an approved emergency process.

2) Please provide (if possible) a short recorded demo of a rotation run and verification of the test vector (10–12 minutes as you suggested). That will accelerate our review.

3) We'll have one legal ask: can Redwood sign the attestation in DocuSign with a vendor-specified statement about key-wrapping and KEK usage? If yes, we'll proceed with the last validation step.

If you can get the signed DocuSign envelope to us by COB 2029-09-30 that would be ideal. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Asha
Head of Security Assurance
FinServe Capital
asha.menon@finserve.com
